neuro.cdr_global.formula:
Memory (M) is primary; the other five are secondary.
1. If at least three secondaries equal M, CDR = M.
2. If three or more secondaries fall on one side of M (above or below), CDR = the score of the majority of those secondaries.
3. If three secondaries fall on one side and two on the other, CDR = M.
4. Ties on one side of M: use the tied score closest to M.
5. If only one or two secondaries equal M and no more than two fall on either side, CDR = M.
Special cases: M = 0.5 → CDR = 1 if at least three secondaries ≥ 1, else 0.5 (never 0). M = 0 → CDR = 0 unless two or more secondaries ≥ 0.5, then 0.5. M ≥ 1 → CDR never 0; CDR = 0.5 if the majority of secondaries are 0.
